caption: The drawing depicts a single, square piece of fabric placed on a plain, light-colored background. The fabric appears to be a shawl or scarf, folded diagonally so that it forms a diamond shape. The central area of the fabric is dark blue, featuring a subtle pattern of small, repeating dark dots or motifs. Surrounding this central area is a wide border with horizontal bands of color, primarily shades of red, pink, and light purple, decorated with repetitive floral or star-shaped patterns in darker red and black. The border is enclosed by a solid dark blue strip, and the fabric is finished with fringes along the two outer edges, with the fringe threads blending from blue to red and pink hues. The fabric’s detailed patterning and blending of colors are all rendered with a high level of precision and clarity. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present, and the background remains plain and unadorned except for a small label or signature at the lower right quadrant of the image.
title: Brocade Kerchief
